incident_text: Portfolio pages and syncs are slow or timing out since about 10:40. Connection pool alerts are firing.

truth.description: A database migration rebuilt the holdings table without recreating its indexes, so queries do sequential scans and slow down; connection-pool exhaustion is a consequence.

logs.msg: slow query: seq scan on holdings took {latency_ms}ms
connection pool exhausted: {pool_in_use}/{pool_max} connections in use

changes.note: rebuild holdings table; indexes not recreated

trap: pool exhaustion in aa-sync looks like the cause but is an effect; the trigger was a migration, not a service deploy
